1 published version of [Build on VoiceDebrief: the techniques from our iPhone and iPad voice app that any team can take into its own, from recording without loss and transcribing offline on the device to debriefs by Apple Intelligence, controlling an app by voice, three layers of intelligence and a CI pipeline that lets agents build a native app without a Mac, with a prompt to point your own Claude at the code](../build-on-voicedebrief.md). The current one is **v1.0.0**.

v1.0.0 is the article as first published. A change to its text (title, abstract or body) is the next minor version, v1.1.0; a change only to its other details (a LinkedIn link, the release it belongs to) is the next patch, v1.0.1. The list is read from the site's git history at every build, so it cannot be edited by hand and cannot leave a version out.
